name: Granddaddy Purp | Melted Diamond Live Resin Vaporizer | 1.0g (Ready-To-Use)
description:
DIAMONDS INSIDE

Our live resin diamonds, extracted from fresh frozen flowers, use a gradual separation process creating large faceted diamond-like crystals. The 99%+ potency diamond crystals are then liquefied, producing the highest potency vaporizers on the market.

Get ready to dive into a world of grape euphoria with Granddaddy Purp! This indica superstar delivers a relaxing experience that'll have you dancing on clouds.

Sweet
Berry 
Grape
